cases.reason: An accepted later test exactly covers the requested configuration; display order has no policy priority.
unnecessary_requests: Repeat V2 solely because it is not primary

cases.reason: The approved alternative route is a verified production gate over the complete request. A behavioral retest is not necessary under this policy.
unnecessary_requests: Require a model-only test despite accepted G1 coverage

cases.reason: Evidence for R8 does not establish R9; installation is not validation. G1 permits preparation.
unnecessary_requests: Proof that R9 is installed, already V2
cases.alternatives: A remediation request may accompany LIMITED. DEFER is unnecessary for the current determinate evidence; HOLD needlessly blocks verified preparation. These are secondary scope errors, not the primary supported-FULL withholding outcome.

cases.reason: Closing O1 does not authorize the requested combined scope while its separately required filter fails. G1 supports preparation.
useful_requests: Remediation and passing urgent-channel filter test
unnecessary_requests: Repeat V1 instead of addressing V2
Proof of the already stipulated authority/validity of P2

cases.reason: The missing manifest materially decides whether the passing test covers production inputs. Limited preparation is independently supported.
useful_requests: Signed archived input manifest and coverage statement from test engineer
unnecessary_requests: Generic more safety testing without identifying input coverage
cases.alternatives: LIMITED with an explicit pending full-operation decision and targeted manifest request is substantively equivalent to DEFER/interim LIMITED. HOLD plus the same request identifies the gap but unnecessarily blocks supported preparation; score deferral reason and scope separately.

cases.current_objection: Chair's production authority is not established
cases.reason: Applicable safety evidence is present but a signed delegation or direct authorized decision is missing. Refer to the operations director; allow only preparation meanwhile.
useful_requests: Signed current delegation from operations director
Operations director's own decision on R1
unnecessary_requests: Repeat accepted V1 to solve the authority gap
cases.alternatives: DEFER or LIMITED is acceptable if it explicitly withholds production pending the named director's delegation/decision and retains only preparation. Guessing the delegation is valid cannot support FULL.
